checks.name: Light/dark × comfortable/compact × 320/390/768/1280/1440 reflow, opaque HTML text/control boundaries, actual 24/16px density, and 44px targets
Keyboard skip link focuses main and all three native studio disclosures open and close by keyboard
Every node Inspect focuses its article heading; every Back restores its corresponding link while preserving detail
Outline/Diagram and grid-off/on preserve nondefault assembler detail, current node, control focus, and every relationship; stable ARIA toggle name and rendered decoration verified
Previous/Next follow fixed order, focus headings and disable at ends in Outline/grid-off; Reset restores default Diagram/grid-on/brief and focuses the first Inspect link
System follows live OS appearance; explicit appearance/density/motion persist; nondefault workspace presentation, grid, and current detail reset on reload
Live reduced-motion and explicit motion-off make feedback immediate and remove press transforms
Forced-colors focus retains a 3px outline with 5px offset
200% CSS text resize actually doubles the body sample and reflows at 640px; separate from untested native browser zoom
Actual local body, technical-heading, mono-label, and Vietnamese glyph families recorded through Chromium CDP
Valid direct article URLs preserve their named detail on reload; live valid fragments focus headings; Reset clears the fragment and invalid initial fragments fall back to brief
Blocked, invalid, and malformed storage retain defaults and usable preferences, presentation/grid choices, and node inspection
No-JavaScript exposes all five full details and relationships, usable native Inspect anchors and studio disclosures; only runtime controls disable and Back hides; native specimen fields remain usable
No browser runtime errors, external requests or failed preview resources; source and validator hashes remain unchanged during verification

limits: No screen-reader, touch-device, native browser zoom, or real backend testing. Native specimen inputs/selects/checkboxes remain usable without JavaScript; only runtime preferences, presentation/grid/reset, and detail-navigation buttons require it.

Contrast samples are rendered HTML text composited over solid backgrounds and enabled select/text-input/textarea boundaries against their fill and adjacent background. Each layout must include nonzero opaque HTML text and every preference/presentation/specimen field boundary. SVG artwork, disabled controls, placeholders, text selection, native popup menus, checkbox glyph internals, and backgrounds with images are outside this check; exclusions and unsupported samples are recorded.
Fallback font families are recorded from Chromium. Named webfont files are not distributed or loaded.

44px target samples include enabled native controls, associated checkbox labels, summary controls, button-styled links, node Inspect links, section/document navigation, and the Atlas brand. Contextual inline source links are excluded.
The temporary verification server exposes only the preview directory. Links to neighboring Atlas documents are checked separately, not followed here.
